ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 75% of the surface area, with low-intensity black occupying approximately 25% concentrated in the central notch region and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black pigmentation forming an asymmetric hourglass pattern radiating from the notch; left lobe contains a single vertical high-contrast dark streak; right lobe displays scattered low-contrast grey-scale circular mottling and a distinct small black focal spot in the upper-mid quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; several prominent peaks (2-5 pixels in height relative to local baseline) are visible, particularly on the outer distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward convex sweep terminating in slightly hooked, tapering tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes; faint circular depigmented patches visible on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, thick, vertically-aligned dark linear mark on the medial portion of the left lobe; multiple fine horizontal hairline disruptions near the lower margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical scar on left lobe; significant barnacle encrustations at both lobe tips; several small, dark punctate marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The black central pigmentation is asymmetrical, extending higher and more broadly towards the right lobe compared to the left.
